description: First Al-Noor Modaraba is a perpetual, multi-purpose modaraba — a listed Islamic financing vehicle — managed by Al-Noor Modaraba Management (Private) Limited. It began operations in November 1992 as a specific-purpose trading modaraba and was converted to a multi-purpose perpetual modaraba in 1995. It provides Shariah-compliant financing through ijara, murabaha, musharaka and musawamah, invests in equities, and has traded commodities since inception, including basmati rice under its Shalamar brand.
